name: IHH
recent: IHH Healthcare 近期公告几乎全部是 EPF 的股东权益变动申报，没有涉及合约或企业活动。新闻方面，公司宣布在新加坡、香港和马来西亚裁减近 400 个职位以整合后台，并推进收购 Afiniti Wellness 以扩建柔佛 Gleneagles 医院。最新财报显示营收和净利同比均增长。
notable: 公司宣布在新加坡、香港和马来西亚裁减近 400 个职位，以整合后台职能。
公司推进收购 Afiniti Wellness，用于扩建柔佛 Gleneagles 医院。
公司计划在靠近新加坡的地区将医院床位数量翻倍。
risks: EPF 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间连续多次申报股东权益变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 70.46 亿，净利为 MYR 5.73 亿，净利率 8.1%；营收环比增长 7.5%，净利环比增长 8.5%；营收同比增长 11.9%，净利同比增长 29.3%。

recent_en: IHH Healthcare's recent announcements are almost entirely EPF substantial shareholder changes, with no contracts or corporate activities disclosed. In the news, the company announced cutting close to 400 jobs across Singapore, Hong Kong and Malaysia to streamline back-office operations, and is proceeding with the acquisition of Afiniti Wellness to expand Gleneagles Hospital Johor. The latest financial results show year-on-year growth in both revenue and net profit.
notable_en: The company announced cutting close to 400 jobs across Singapore, Hong Kong and Malaysia to integrate back-office functions.
The company is proceeding with the acquisition of Afiniti Wellness for the expansion of Gleneagles Hospital Johor.
The company plans to double hospital beds in the region near Singapore.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple consecutive substantial shareholder changes between September and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 7.046 billion and net profit was MYR 573 million, with a net margin of 8.1%; revenue grew 7.5% QoQ and net profit grew 8.5% QoQ; revenue grew 11.9% YoY and net profit grew 29.3% YoY.
